# QYL0601: Sensitive data in span attribute

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/Qyl.OpenTelemetry.SemanticConventions.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| -- | -- |
| Severity | Warning |

| Analyzer | `Qyl0601SensitiveDataInAttributeAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

Span attributes containing passwords, secrets, tokens, API keys, or PII (SSN, credit card numbers) can leak sensitive information to telemetry backends. Consider redacting sensitive values or excluding these attributes from telemetry. If the data is intentionally included, suppress this warning with a justification comment.
